summary.text: Rick Jasperse was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2010 and now represents the 11th District.

paragraphs.text: He grew up in Kingsport, Tennessee, and has a food science degree from the University of Georgia's College of Agriculture.
He retired in 2009 after 29 years as a county agent with the University of Georgia College of Agriculture, and has lived in Pickens County since 1983.
